AFWD.justification: the forward movement from a short vowel to a long or open vowel state

AREV.justification: the return to a base articulatory position when a transformation fails to meet the dilation threshold

CLINK.justification: the linear arrangement of characters into a coherent word string

ENGAGR.justification: the momentary overlap where a phoneme exists between its original and promoted values during the dilation process

EVALF.justification: the identification of a non-target phoneme that remains unchanged

EVALT.justification: the successful identification of a target phoneme for dilation

FFUSE.justification: the merging of processed branches back into a single orthographic sequence

FSPLIT.justification: the point where a phoneme enters the probability distribution to determine its promotion path

IFIX.justification: the permanent fixation of the character onto the medium which cannot be reverted

IMSCRIB.justification: the maintenance of the underlying meaning despite the shift in surface character representation

TANCH.justification: the final orthographic representation that contains the transformed phonetic values

VINIT.justification: the raw acoustic potential before phonetic categorization occurs
